verdict.rationale: PayPal documents concrete merchant on-ramps: a catalog feed file for Store Sync, merchant-hosted cart endpoints that PayPal's Shopping Cart calls, and Braintree-based ACP and UCP checkout guides. None of these is truly self-serve. Agentic commerce services and Store Sync require submitting an access form and waiting for the PayPal AI team to onboard you. UCP requires Google merchant registration, and the Agent Ready paths require an existing Braintree account plus a custom build (an MCP server and ChatGPT app for ACP). Store Sync is also limited to US physical goods in USD. Missing for 10: a self-serve toggle or agreement with no approval gate, availability to plain PayPal accounts without Braintree or a form, broader eligibility beyond US physical goods, and independent hands-on onboarding corroboration.
